title: Light Garlicky Turkish Duck Bake
description: A satvik-friendly Turkish dish featuring duck fat, garlic, and a light, gooey texture, this bake is perfect for a special occasion, with a delicious and aromatic flavor profile that is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the minced garlic and duck fat.
Season the duck breast with paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the duck breast in a baking dish and brush the garlic and duck fat mixture evenly over both breasts.
Drizzle the olive oil and lemon juice over the duck breast.
Bake the duck breast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the duck breast from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Slice the duck breast into thin strips and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the duck breast hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
